convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load 'ColorBBCandles' custom indicator, and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). Custom indicator and external .mqh dependency require manual translation.

other_exits: Flat signal exit: when ColorBBCandles buffer4[1] == 5, both long and short positions are closed (if respective close permissions are enabled)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing. Logic handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 4 from the ColorBBCandles custom indicator. This buffer returns an integer-like color index: values >5 = bullish candle (buy zone), values <5 = bearish candle (sell zone), value ==5 = flat/neutral zone. Buy signal triggers when Value[1]>5 (previous signal bar is bullish) AND Value[0]<6 (current bar is not yet 6+), with BuyPosOpen permission. Sell signal triggers when Value[1]<5 AND Value[0]>4, with SellPosOpen permission. SignalBar input (default 1) determines which bar's data is used for signal detection. When SignalBar==0, the EA recalculates every tick instead of only on new bars. Position close and open permissions are independently configurable (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose). The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to the next bar's open time and passed to trade functions.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The ColorBBCandles custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It appears to be a multi-deviation Bollinger Band candle coloring system where buffer 4 returns a color index (1-10 scale, 5=neutral). 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains the actual trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) including position sizing from MM parameter, SL/TP setting, and position existence checks - this must be reimplemented. 3. The conditional MM sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) is inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh and needs careful translation. 4. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - may need 5-digit broker adjustment depending on how TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles it. 5. The IsNewBar check and history loading (LoadHistory) are MQL5-specific patterns that need Python equivalents. 6. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh manages bar detection.
